h1: The shower is cold, but other taps are hot
title: The shower is cold, but other taps are hot | G3 Cylinder Help
description: Understand the shower is cold, but other taps are hot. Distinguish the symptom, gather useful details and arrange competent cylinder assessment in London.
answer: A single affected shower with hot delivery elsewhere points toward a local outlet or mixing investigation before assuming the cylinder has failed.

sections.heading: What this symptom can mean
paragraphs: A mixer needs suitable hot and cold supplies. Restrictions, mixer components or imbalance may affect one outlet. A whole-cylinder replacement is not justified solely by a single-shower symptom.

sections.heading: Information to gather safely
paragraphs: Record whether flow and temperature both change and whether another shower behaves normally. Do not dismantle a mixer or cylinder valve based on an online guess.

sections.heading: How the enquiry becomes an investigation
paragraphs: The cylinder make, full model and heating arrangement should be identified first. The same visible symptom can arise from different causes, and a relief device may be protecting the system rather than creating the original problem. Component testing and any repair belong to a person competent for the work.

sections.heading: Discuss the appropriate next step
paragraphs: Call 020 7205 4433 with the postcode, symptom history and any previous service findings. The enquiry establishes the proposed assessment and availability. Do not use this guide as a substitute for the actual appliance safety instructions or an on-site diagnosis.

faqs.question: Why should a cold shower be assessed differently when basin taps are hot?
faqs.answer: Hot delivery elsewhere suggests heat is available; the shower mixer and its local supplies may need investigation before cylinder work is proposed.
